principle: The physical source witness archives are separate from the continuous English reading archive. A manuscript witness is never confused with a complete book, a study description, or an editorial reconstruction.

archives.title: Ben Sira / Sirach Manuscript and Version Archive
archives.scope: Independent direct Hebrew manuscript witnesses, indirect medieval paraphrase evidence, and separate Greek and Syriac versional witnesses for Sirach.
archives.coverage_rule: Every direct Hebrew manuscript remains separate. Kahana's 1912 edition is an editorial edition, not one ancient manuscript. The Rhyming Paraphrase is indirect evidence only. Greek and Syriac remain in their own languages and are never silently retroverted into Hebrew. A passage range does not prove every word survives.
archives.completion_status: in progress; passage-level manuscript comparison, Genizah and Masada transcription permissions, and remaining gaps still require work

archives.title: Codex Sinaiticus Archive
archives.scope: Codex Sinaiticus (GA 01) as an individual Greek parchment codex
archives.coverage_rule: A separate witness archive; do not merge its readings into Vaticanus or papyrus transcriptions.

archives.title: Codex Vaticanus Archive
archives.scope: Codex Vaticanus (GA 03) as an individual Greek parchment codex
archives.coverage_rule: Show the Vaticanus transcription independently. Missing leaves and lacunae remain missing in the witness archive; other manuscripts may supply those passages only in the separate reconstructed English reading, with source attribution.

archives.title: Dead Sea Scrolls Archive
archives.coverage_rule: Only passages actually preserved by each identified scroll are presented as witness text. Restored letters, editorial reconstructions, and lacunae remain identified.
archives.priority: Hebrew writings and Qumran witnesses where relevant

archives.title: Unified English Readings
archives.scope: Continuous English reading text for each writing in the Unified Apostolic and Disciple Writings collection
archives.coverage_rule: Reader contains only the actual English reading. It is distinct from study notes and manuscript archives. Missing passages are supplied only from a named, verified witness or critical edition that preserves the passage; otherwise the gap is identified, not invented.

archives.title: Papyrus Archive
archives.scope: Individual Greek papyrus manuscripts, codices, and fragments
archives.coverage_rule: Every papyrus is a distinct physical witness. Fragmentary verse coverage never means a complete verse or book is preserved. Greek witness transcription and its English translation remain paired and clearly labelled.

reading_workflow: Establish the full extent of the writing and chapter/section structure.
Inventory early and trusted witnesses for every passage, with priority to the earliest extant manuscripts and relevant ancient versions.
Transcribe or consult each witness independently; preserve its original language and siglum in its own archive.
Collate overlapping witnesses and record significant variants, omissions, additions, and uncertain readings.
Translate the complete recoverable text into clear English, using a declared Greek or Hebrew base text and documented witness support.
Where the primary witness is missing a passage, use another identified witness that preserves that exact passage; record the source of the supplied segment.
Keep study descriptions, dates, and manuscript notes outside the reading body.
Mark a writing complete only after every chapter and known gap has been audited.
